answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware attestation key from a secure enclave, so one physical device can mint exactly one identity. Picture the economy as a river of paid work flowing through a single inlet: every job offer passes a wharf checkpoint that verifies the enclave signature before the agent may bid. Forging a thousand fake identities then means buying a thousand real devices and keeping them powered, turning a free software flood into a hardware bill that grows with each fake. An attacker can still buy devices, but the cost per Sybil is now a physical purchase, not a copy-paste.
